name: team
summary: Ticketed work with two approving reviewers.

phases.name: plan
phases.instruction: Find the Jira ticket, record it with `board jira ref --key <KEY> --site <site>` and attach it with --ticket. Write the plan.

checks.remedy: Ask the owner for the ticket key if none is named; record it with `board jira ref` and attach it with `changes.attach --path {change} --ticket <path>`.

phases.name: build
phases.instruction: Build test-first and attach a run of {suite} on the head.

phases.name: review
phases.instruction: Request two reviews from different people on {head}; record each report.

checks.remedy: Two different people must approve {head}. Ask for the missing approvals and stop.

phases.name: land
phases.instruction: Open the pull request with `board changes pr`.
